title: fix(plugin-security): explain reports a Modify All-superseded row-conditioned field lock as binding on no row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96ws2DLQgZkin2u7GFC6oDF)_
Fixes #29610

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os explain` 的字段级说明层，对持有 Modify All Data 的调用者，不再把带 `when` 行条件的字段锁说成"按行判、其余处一律锁"，改为单列一句"已被 Modify All 字段票覆盖，锁在任何行都不生效"，并点名持票的权限集。
- 为什么改：裁决 6573563853 字母 A（#29387 已落地）后，Modify All 的字段票在逐条票之后、任何 `when` 判定下都把每个字段投为可编辑；说明文字却还在讲锁，管理员排查字段权限时会被误导。
- 风险与回滚：只改说明文字，执行面零改动；回滚即 revert 本 PR。View All 与无票调用者的句子与今天一致。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts`（`conditionedFieldEntries` 读同一个 `superuserFieldVote`）、`explain-engine.ts` 的 `conditionedSentence`、`explain-engine.test.ts` 三条 `[#29610]` 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/explain-engine.test.ts -t 29610`，预期 3 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The FLS layer of the access explanation listed every field permission that carries a `when` as "judged per row by the write gate, applied as the lock everywhere else". For a caller whose sets hold Modify All Data on the object that was untrue: since ruling of record 6573563853 letter A (PR #29387), `getFieldPermissions` applies the super-user field vote after the per-entry votes, under every `when` verdict, so such a lock binds on no row. Measured through the public explain route (see Verification): the write gate admits the field for that caller while the report called it locked.

- **Seam (no second copy of the rule).** `PermissionEvaluator.conditionedFieldEntries` now names, per entry, the sets whose Modify All vote supersedes it (`supersededBy`). It reads `superuserFieldVote` from `@objectstack/core`, the same function `getFieldPermissions` applies, and attributes the sets through `superuserBypassSets` (the one `holdsSuperuserBypass` predicate). No extraction was needed: the vote already lives in core and both readers now call it. The explain engine only words the result.
- **Wording: annotate, not drop.** Superseded entries move into their own sentence, in the "Superseded by the View/Modify All Data bypass [...]" form the record-level sharing attribution already uses: `N row-conditioned field permission(s) are superseded by the Modify All Data field vote [SETS], which votes every field editable on every row, so the lock binds on no row: [...]`. Entries the vote does not supersede keep the existing sentence, counted on their own.
- **View All supersedes nothing.** It votes only the read bit, which a conditioned entry already casts (the spec refuses `readable: false` beside a `when`), so the edit lock still binds per row. Measured: the write gate refuses the field on a matching row for a View All holder.
- **D10.** Each principal's entries are judged against its own sets. The agent and delegator masks intersect, so a delegator's lock still binds when only the agent holds the vote.
- The hidden/partial mask is untouched. Enforcement is unchanged.

Forced test edit: `security-plugin.test.ts` `[#25866] conditionedFieldEntries lists the row-conditioned entries of the object, as authored` pins the entry shape with `toEqual`, so both expected entries gain `supersededBy: []`.

## Tests

`explain-engine.test.ts`, next to the `[#25866]` row-condition test:

- `[#29610] a Modify All set supersedes a row-conditioned lock` — the entry is listed as superseded by the vote, names the set, and is not called "judged per row".
- `[#29610] a View All set does NOT supersede it` — read-side control: the row-conditioned sentence stays.
- `[#29610] a caller without the vote keeps the row-conditioned sentence` — control.

## Acceptance notes

- `ConditionedFieldEntry` gains a required output member `supersededBy`. It is reachable only as the return type of the exported `PermissionEvaluator.conditionedFieldEntries`; nothing in the repo builds one besides the evaluator. The seat ruled this public return-shape enlargement a widening (contract review 6591028293, claim amended in 6591039615), so the PR body and the changeset declare `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; `Metadata-protocol: none` and the patch level stand.
- Related and not in scope: #29544 (lint for the super-user bit beside a mask), #29543 (`when` description wording).

## Verification

Head `8ec800e4` (fix `ca1b6e6a`, the round-2 changeset declaration commit, and merges of `origin/main`; the latest merge brought `plugin-security` files from main, so the package runs and gates below were repeated on this head).

<details><summary>Measurement through the public explain route, before and after (scratch dogfood boot, not committed)</summary>

A throwaway dogfood boot measured three callers that each hold a `when`-conditioned field entry on one object: one without the vote (control), one with View All, one with Modify All. Each read the explain route's FLS layer, and the write gate's answer for that field on a row the condition names was read beside it.

- Write gate: control refused, View All refused, Modify All admitted (the ruled behaviour).
- Before (main `5bd615ef`): all three were told the entry is "judged per row by the write gate, applied as the lock everywhere else", Modify All included.
- After (`ca1b6e6a`): control and View All unchanged; Modify All reads "2 row-conditioned field permission(s) are superseded by the Modify All Data field vote [the MA set], which votes every field editable on every row, so the lock binds on no row".

</details>

<details><summary>Red first on main, ablation</summary>

- Red on main (tests added, fix absent): `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed` — the Modify All case: `expected 'No field-level masking applies. 1 fie…' not to contain 'judged per row by the write gate'`.
- Ablation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `permission-evaluator.ts`: the vote read was disabled with a string-literal guard. Anchor 1 to 0, blob f0269b4c to 57f704a0. Same failure, `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed`. Restored: blob equals HEAD f0269b4c, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the evaluator from `src` by relative path, so no dist leg applies.

</details>

<details><summary>Package runs and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: Test Files 241 passed (241), Tests 5205 passed, 45 skipped (5250). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0, on `ca1b6e6a`, `1fcfe8f5` and `8ec800e4` (5206 passed on the last, one test more from main).
- Lint: root eslint `--no-inline-config` on `packages/plugins/plugin-security` exit 0 (the package has no lint script).
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on `8ec800e4` (and before it on `1fcfe8f5`): 62 derived, 62 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. On `1fcfe8f5` three gates first exited on a missing prerequisite (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 needed the pinned fixture commit fetched; `check:dts-closure` exit 1 and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 needed a declaration build of every package) and were re-run green after it.
- Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

</details>
